reason: 89 dollars a month is over a thousand a year, about a fifth of what I take home. For a shop with 4 staff and a notebook plus Telegram, that is far too much, even if Click and Payme work.
objection: Will it still exist and be supported in a year? I would pay 89 dollars every month and if the company disappears I lose all my client data.
would_change_my_mind: A much cheaper small plan, around 15 to 20 dollars a month, plus free help moving my clients over and proof the company has been around and has other shops like mine using it.
